action_items: Backend suite completed with no collected tests; the acceptance matrix contains no backend API behavior beyond the existing connectivity route.

checks.criterion: Navidha storefront renders the redesign shell with supplied logo, premium editorial hero, navigation, craft heritage section, collection section, philosophy, and launch section
checks.name: navidha-storefront-shell
checks.evidence: Rendered / with hero title, collection, craft, philosophy, and waitlist sections visible; navigation clicks reached #collection and #craft.

checks.criterion: Catalog supports browsing and category filtering
checks.name: catalog-category-filtering
checks.evidence: Category Rings changed result count from 8 pieces to 2 and showed Gulabi Bloom Ring while hiding Moonlit Pearl Collar.

checks.criterion: Catalog supports material filtering, search, and sorting
checks.name: catalog-controls-update-edit
checks.evidence: Pearls filtered to 2, search Moonlit filtered to 1, price sort remained usable, and Clear filters restored 8 pieces. Initial assertion expected singular grammar; rerun with rendered UI text passed.

checks.criterion: A product opens a detail view
checks.name: product-detail-modal-opens
checks.evidence: Moonlit Pearl Collar modal displayed name, Pearls material/category, INR 14,800 price, description, specs, and close control.

checks.criterion: Customer can add a product to the shopping bag
checks.name: product-adds-to-bag
checks.evidence: Detail Add to bag updated navbar count to 1, opened the bag, and displayed success toast.

checks.criterion: Customer can review and edit the shopping bag
checks.name: shopping-bag-editing
checks.evidence: Bag listed Quiet Arc Hoops; increase changed quantity to 2, subtotal displayed INR 14,400, and remove returned to empty state.

checks.criterion: Waitlist interaction works as a local demo
checks.name: waitlist-local-submit
checks.evidence: Valid email submission displayed 'You are on the list' and kept the waitlist section usable; this is intentionally a LOCAL DEMO interaction.

checks.name: mobile-nav-and-drawer
checks.evidence: At 390x844 mobile viewport, navigation toggle opened mobile navigation, collection link navigated, detail modal fit, and bag drawer opened.
